profile_authority.detail: The existing in-memory ServiceGraph.set_processing_profile is the only profile authority. Settings retains conversion/DSP consent and quality profile; no second profile store or preset was added.

compile_and_install.detail: The selected ProcessingProfile graph is resolved/compiled with EffectiveProcessingGraphResolver and ProcessingGraphCompiler, then installed through AudioProcessingService.begin_candidate/commit_candidate. effective_after_start.detail: The child may commit with configured caps while the pipeline is still quiescent; EFFECTIVE is published only after host-confirmed START and a negotiated F06 readback. A failed finalize retires the execution and never publishes EFFECTIVE. EOS and stop both retire EFFECTIVE; EOS does not leave a false effective processing truth.
